response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM dc) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district di ON di.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY di.A3

assumptions.assumption: Counting a client once per owned account means counting OWNER disposition rows (one per client-account pair), grouped by the account's district_id; a client owning several accounts in the same district is counted once per account.
The share denominator is the total of the per-district counts over all districts with at least one client (all regions), not the regional total.
